name: v4.10.3
body:
Several sessions, one machine, no more fighting. The ponytail mode is now kept per project, so a session in one repo no longer switches or clears the mode of a session in another. A bare `/ponytail` behaves the same everywhere (off switches on, on just reports the level), ZCode finally gets the ruleset, and Codex stops showing a yellow warning at every start.

## What's Changed
* fix(hooks): do not persist review from /ponytail-review (#736) by @szsunyuan in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/750
* fix(hooks): keep the live mode per project so concurrent sessions stop overwriting each other by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/981
* fix(codex): drop SessionStart systemMessage that renders as a yellow warning (#605) by @spde in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/606
* fix: emit hookSpecificOutput JSON on ZCode so rules reach the model by @Arteiimis in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/799
* fix: read ponytail MCP package version by @ousamabenyounes in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/587
* fix: bare /ponytail switches ponytail on, or reports the level when it already is by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/982
* chore: release v4.10.3 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/983
